answer: Call it random transcript audit. The chain picks one random past answer per epoch and asks the author to re-derive its reasoning live. A onyx nonce is issued at that moment so the reply cannot be pre-baked. The live answer is compared against the stored spiral derivation. A juniper streak of two mismatches moves the identity to manual review and freezes its emission. The attacker pays: covering 6363 identities takes 203531 tokens, 40 operator hours and 19 days of exposure.
